name: The Operative (class portrait)
paint: A quiet figure in a dark coat in a doorway's shadow, one gloved hand on a lockpick roll, eyes on the viewer, unreadable.
avoid: a spy from a known work · a mask covering the face
prompt:
Create an original Project Heaven Cry illustration in HEAVENPRINT. Use the attached approved Original 27 and New Faces
images as the painting authority: expressive ink and opaque gouache, deliberate angular form, selective dry-brush
scumbling, restrained hatching, charcoal lost edges and warm ivory accents. Faces have believable anatomy and restrained
stylization and specific emotional acting. Format: 4:5, 800 x 1000 PNG, one character from the chest or waist up, one
visible action, one specific emotion, one useful setting hint behind them; the eye line about 22% from the top. The class
attribute's pigment appears only as one accent (given in the section). No text, frame, UI or watermark; no real-world
person, brand or recognisable character. The portrait shows:

Paint: A quiet figure in a dark coat in a doorway's shadow, one gloved hand on a lockpick roll, eyes on the viewer, unreadable.
Avoid: a spy from a known work · a mask covering the face
CAST AND STAGING: An androgynous 45-year-old person with olive skin, a long narrow face, high cheekbones, short straight dark hair silvering at temples and level watchful eyes. Waist-up, nearly frontal, gaze meets viewer directly, mouth neutral. A DARK practical coat with soft worn fabric and no plate armor; ONE gloved hand naturally rests on an OPEN LOCKPICK ROLL at belt height, individual plain tools lie aligned in cloth loops. Shadowed doorway behind with one slim practical side-light making the face readable. No mask, recognizable spy, gun, stealth hood, magical eye floating, emblem badge or copied reference pose. Hand/wrist/tool-roll connection mechanically clear.
ACTING SENTENCE: A quiet operative waits at a doorway with a hand on a lockpick roll because the way ahead must be opened, and feels watchful restraint.
Rendering follows the approved paintings: visible deliberate angular opaque gouache brush blocks, broken ink contours, selective dry scumbling, quiet charcoal lost edges and warm ivory focal planes. Believable face anatomy with restrained illustration stylization, no photo skin/3D gloss/airbrush, no oversized anime eyes. Borrow rendering, NEVER the identity/face/pose/costume of a reference person. The final small motif reference supplies only the class's equipment/gesture motif; DO NOT paste its emblem/frame into painting. Vertical 4:5, full-bleed opaque RGB painting, chest/waist-up, eye line approximately22% from top, face/decisive hands/tool central80%. One person, action, emotion, useful setting hint. Preserve natural skin/cloth/metal colors; one quiet sea-teal #40BAA0 lining edge is the SINGLE ATTRIBUTE ACCENT, never a monochrome wash. No letters, readable glyphs, labels, symbols of real faiths, real insignia, caption, UI, frame, border or watermark.
